product.name: Monoprice 2-Port Cat5e RJ45 Surface Mount Box UL TAA Dual IDC 50u No Logo White
product.description: This white plastic box is a surface‑mounted dual Cat5e keystone box intended for use when in‑wall or other installations are not possible. The cover can be easily removed to allow access to the wire connections. Use a 110D or Krone type impact to crimp and connect the wires. It can be used with stranded or solid Cat5e cable of any gauge. It includes double‑sided tape and two screws, allowing you to choose the mounting method that best fits your needs. Installation instructions are included.Support Files: User's Manual (Aug 14, 2012)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. Updated Jan 19, 2022 Warning: This product can expose you to Lead, which is known to the State of California to cause cancer and reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
